'''Collaris''' was a noted advocate in [[Tanchico]].

==History==
While growing up, Collaris instilled a love of the intricacies of law in her granddaughter [[Beonin Marinye]]. Collaris' daughter, [[Aeldrine Marinye]], went on to become a [[merchant]], something of which Collaris disapproved.{{ref/book|11|2}}

==Activities==
On her way to the [[White Tower]], Beonin looks over some jewelry passed on to her by her mother and grandmother. These mementos make her think of them.{{ref/book|11|2}}
